events.title: Hidden Layers: AI Infrastructures and Hallucinations — Opening Reception
events.why: Seventeen international artists expose what AI hides: planetary infrastructures, colonial underpinnings, hallucinations, and silent cultural reprocessing. Free opening at Worth Ryder Gallery with artist talk by Gregory Chatonsky.

events.title: CROSSROADS 2026 — San Francisco Cinematheque x Gray Area
events.why: Cinematheque's 17th annual experimental film festival: 49 works by 52 artists across 22 countries in 8 programs, with JG Thirlwell live-scoring Harry Smith's occult classic Heaven and Earth Magic.

events.title: Sounds of SWANA: Afghan Cassette Archive and Mazikaa
events.why: The Afghan Cassette Archive documents a moment when synthesizers met traditional Afghan pop. Interactive listening session with Mazikaa at RootStock Arts Center — media archaeology you can dance to.

events.title: Bilingual Dimond Park Bioblitz — Sausal Creek Biodiversity Day
events.why: Bilingual English/Spanish biodiversity day with Friends of Sausal Creek, El Timpano, and Cal Academy. Guided creek walks, iNaturalist logging, free lunch, and raffle at Dimond Park.

events.title: San Francisco Zine Fest 25th Anniversary
events.why: 25th anniversary with RE/Search founder V. Vale as guest of honor, plus Penelope Houston of the Avengers. Punk history, underground self-publishing, 200+ exhibitors, zine-making workshop.

events.title: Push Buttons and AI — BAMPFA Alternative Visions
events.why: Film program on automation and AI's social infrastructures paired with the Hidden Layers exhibit. Gibbs Chapman's Push Button plus works on chatbot affect, AI labor, and model collapse, with curators in conversation.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory — Benjamin Bratton and Marek Poliks
events.why: Bratton (Antikythera) and Poliks (Disintegrator) present a double-lecture on how trillions of AI agents and fully automated agentic systems will reconfigure society. Speculative technology at its most rigorous.

events.title: Heart Trio: William Parker, Hamid Drake, Cooper-Moore
events.why: Three legends of creative music reunited on guembri, shakuhachi, hand-crafted ashimba, and frame drum. Collectively improvised, deeply humanist, and deliberately anti-acceleration.

events.title: San Francisco Electronic Music Festival 2026
events.why: 25th annual festival at The Lab: three nights with Moor Mother, Rrose, Paul DeMarinis, Blevin Blectum, IDHAZ, and Thomas Carnacki across the experimental electronic spectrum.

events.title: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu
events.why: Xiu Xiu channels Eraserhead through homemade instruments, modular synths, field recordings, and musique concrete. A live concert and film reimagining Lynch's midnight masterpiece at Gray Area.

events.title: Unseen Visions: A New Age Music and Culture Symposium
events.why: Two-day symposium on New Age music and culture: performances by Robert Rich, Steven Halpern, and Kat Epple; screenings of Jordan Belson films; and talks by Erik Davis and scholar Jacob Smith.
